_README: PREVIEW / UNCONFIRMED. Wiki harvest of the 20 named items attributed to the raid "Terror of the Demon Lords" (Terror of Demogorgon pack, Legendary CR 37), an Update 81 dot-release addition. Every one of these pages is tagged {{Lamannia}} on the wiki (one exception, recorded below) — Lamannia is the public PREVIEW server, so these numbers are pre-release and routinely change before they go live. This file is a STAGING artifact and is deliberately NOT wired into the build: nothing globs data/seed/compendium/raw/, every consumer names its input file explicitly (gearplanner_items/crafting/sets/affix_synonyms), so adding this file cannot reach the solver by accident. Do not parse these into affixes, do not stamp wiki_confirmed, and do not promote any of it until the raid is live and the {{Lamannia}} banners are gone from the pages. Promotion procedure is in docs/wiki-evidence/lamannia-preview-demon-lords-raid.md.
source: ddowiki.com MediaWiki API (action=query&prop=revisions&rvslots=main), same-origin from a ddowiki tab
ddo_update: Update 81 (dot release; not present in the U81.0.1/81.1/81.1.1/81.2 release notes as of harvest)
_transcription_note: Wikitext was carried browser->repo through the get_page_text DOM bridge, which collapses runs of whitespace. Template field alignment padding (the spaces before "=") is therefore NOT byte-identical to the wiki source; nothing else differs. Verified 2026-09-05 by comparing SHA-256 of whitespace-normalized wikitext per item, browser vs repo: 20/20 match.
_banner_exception: These pages carry no {{Lamannia}} banner: Item:The Unspeakable Power. Treat as preview anyway — the omission is more likely an editor slip than a promotion, since the item shares the raid, ML and chest of the other 19. Re-check at promotion time.
